body:
Owner (post-01M1DFRYKJQ03KXSTV9AE7XWE6): yes. The paper’s own Data/Code availability statements point at GitHub and a Zenodo archive.

- https://github.com/ryanapanela/EventRecall
- Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17467024

The repo claims the manuscript data: data/stories (the Trevor Noah excerpts), data/segmentation (human, GPT, LLaMA), data/recall (recall transcripts and preprocessed scores), plus the analysis scripts. They note there is no single raw-to-plot pipeline because LLM outputs are nondeterministic even at low temperature.

Two custody facts before anyone clones it into this checkout:

1. Those recall transcripts are participant speech. They do not enter storymodel4s until they pass docs/design/story-text-admission-checklist.md and the owner records an REB basis. Reproduce in an authorized environment.
2. The source chapters are from a copyrighted memoir. Do not paste them into this repository.

Scout’s A–F experiment can use that GitHub as the named EventRecall baseline. It cannot use this repo as the dump site.
